The learner asks specifically: Make sure one of the senses is this meaning: the main evening meal.

notes: In Mexico, the main meal of the day is 'la comida' (eaten in the afternoon). 'La cena' is eaten in the evening (around 8 or 9 PM) and is usually lighter, unless it is a social occasion.

senses.definition: The meal eaten in the evening, or a social gathering for this meal.

examples.text: Preparé una sopa caliente para la cena.
examples.translation: I made a hot soup for dinner.
examples.emotion: proud and caring, serving a comforting meal after a long day

examples.text: Tenemos una cena con amigos el sábado.
examples.translation: We have a dinner with friends on Saturday.

notes: In Spain and parts of Latin America, la cena is eaten quite late in the evening, often around 9:00 PM or later.

senses.definition: The main meal of the evening, eaten at the end of the day.

examples.text: Preparé una sopa caliente para la cena.
examples.translation: I prepared a hot soup for dinner.
examples.emotion: proud and caring, serving a comforting meal after a long day

senses.definition: A social gathering or party where people eat an evening meal together.

examples.text: Tenemos una cena con los amigos el sábado.
examples.translation: We have a dinner with friends on Saturday.
examples.emotion: excited and sociable, looking forward to a fun weekend gathering

faults.quote: The main meal of the evening, eaten at the end of the day.
faults.why: In Mexico, 'la comida' (afternoon) is the main meal; 'la cena' is usually light.

faults.quote: (party) A social gathering or party where people eat an evening meal
